rationale: Given the conference emphasis on an integrated, text-driven reading of §§ 541.602(a) and 541.604(b), the opinion is most likely assigned to Justice Barrett (or retained by the Chief) to produce a clean, administrable rule rejecting a “high pay” carveout. Separate writings are most likely from Justice Gorsuch (and possibly Justices Thomas/Alito) to underscore no-deference/Kisor themes and to caution against purpose-based relaxation of clear regulatory prerequisites.
